items.title: Account panel identifies the active user
items.precondition: Signed in with a display name; username and avatar are available when possible.
steps: Open the avatar menu from any authenticated route.
Confirm the account summary shows the current avatar, display name, and @username when present.
Select the summary and confirm it navigates to the current user's profile.
items.expected: One clearly interactive account summary routes to the profile with no nested-link behavior.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: User confirmed manual signed-in testing of the account summary, including identity display and profile navigation.

items.title: Existing account actions retain their behavior
items.precondition: Signed in; use a disposable test session for logout.
steps: Open the menu and confirm no separate View profile row is present.
Open the menu again and select Log out.
items.expected: The menu has one profile entry only; the theme changes and logout terminates the session exactly as before.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: User confirmed manual signed-in testing; no separate View profile row remains, theme switching works, and logout retains its behavior.

items.title: Theme action reflects the next state
steps: Open the menu in light mode and inspect the theme row.
Switch theme, reopen the menu, and inspect the same row.
items.expected: Light mode offers Sun/Moon copy for switching to dark; dark mode offers the inverse, with a matching icon.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: User confirmed the light/dark mode action has been manually tested in both states.

items.title: Keyboard, focus, and dismissal remain accessible
steps: Tab to the avatar trigger and open it with Enter or Space.
Use arrow keys to traverse the menu and Enter to select a non-logout action.
Reopen it and dismiss with Escape; inspect visible focus treatment.
items.expected: Radix menu navigation and dismissal work; focus is visible and action rows are comfortably targetable.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: User confirmed manual interaction testing of the profile menu controls.

items.title: Theme and consumer isolation
items.precondition: Signed in; profile page is accessible.
steps: Inspect the account panel in light and dark modes.
Open a ProfilePage overflow or avatar-image menu that uses profile-dropdown classes.
items.expected: Account panel has intentional contrast in both themes, while profile-page menus preserve their prior styling and behavior.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: User confirmed manual visual testing of the menu changes, including light/dark presentation and isolation from existing profile menus.

items.title: Frontend automated gates pass
items.precondition: Execution changes are present on kylie/profile-menu-ui.
steps: Run npm run typecheck in frontend.
Run npm run lint in frontend.
Run npm run build in frontend.
items.expected: Commands exit successfully; any pre-existing warning is documented separately.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: npm run typecheck passed in the root and frontend; npm run lint completed with six existing warnings outside this change; npm run build passed in frontend; npm run build:api passed in the root.
items.notes: The root package does not define the Constitution-documented npm run check:all script; npm reported Missing script.
